# IRFATECH
> Digital infrastructure company helping SMBs in India automate, organize, and grow digitally.

## About IRFATECH
IRFATECH (Integrated Resources For Automation) is a B2B business technology and automation company founded by Muhammad Irfan in 2009. With 15+ years of software development experience, IRFATECH builds ERP systems, CRM solutions, custom software, AI automation workflows, and business websites for small and medium businesses (SMBs) primarily in West Bengal, India — including Kolkata, Siliguri, and surrounding regions.

IRFATECH is founder-led, not a typical software agency. The company focuses on long-term partnerships, helping businesses reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and scale through technology.

## Services

### ERP Solutions
Odoo-based ERP implementation and customization for SMBs. Covers inventory management, billing and invoicing, purchase orders, CRM, HR and payroll, accounting, multi-branch operations, and reporting. Typical implementation: 3–12 weeks depending on complexity.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/erp-solutions

### CRM & Sales Automation
Customer relationship management systems for lead tracking, sales pipeline management, automated follow-ups, and customer communication. Built to help sales teams close more deals without manual effort.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/crm-automation

### AI & Workflow Automation
AI-powered workflows that automate repetitive business tasks — document processing, customer query handling, lead qualification, data entry, and report generation. No tech team required to maintain once set up.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/ai-workflows

### WhatsApp Automation
WhatsApp Business API integration for automated customer communication. Includes auto-replies, order updates, appointment reminders, lead follow-ups, and broadcast messaging. Critical for Indian SMBs where WhatsApp is the primary business communication channel.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/whatsapp-automation

### Custom Software Development
Tailor-built dashboards, portals, and business applications using Laravel (PHP) and Vue.js. For businesses whose processes don't fit off-the-shelf software.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/custom-software

### Business Websites
Professional business websites built to generate leads and build credibility. Designed for SMBs that need an online presence that converts visitors into customers.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/websites

### Mobile App Development
iOS and Android business applications for field teams, customers, and management. Cross-platform development optimised for Indian business operations.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/mobile-apps

### Maintenance & Support
Ongoing monitoring, updates, and priority support for all systems built by IRFATECH. SLA-based plans with dedicated support contact.
URL: https://irfatech.in/services/maintenance

## Industries Served
- Retail Shops (POS, inventory, customer management)
- Distributors & Wholesalers (supply chain, billing, logistics)
- Clinics & Healthcare (patient records, appointments, billing)
- Real Estate Agencies (property listings, CRM, Landflix platform)
- Restaurants & Hospitality (orders, menu management, analytics)
- Coaching Centers & Educational Institutes (enrollment, scheduling, payments)
- SMB Enterprises (end-to-end digital business infrastructure)

## Flagship Product: Landflix
Landflix is IRFATECH's own SaaS product — a modern real estate technology platform for property discovery, management, and digital real estate operations in India.
URL: https://irfatech.in/landflix

## Technology Stack
- Backend: Laravel (PHP)
- Frontend: Vue.js, Tailwind CSS
- ERP Platform: Odoo (open-source)
- Mobile: Cross-platform web-based applications
- Automation: AI-driven workflows, WhatsApp Business API
- Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL
